literal_meaning: অন্ন দিয়ে গঠিত কোষ (sheath made of food)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার অন্নময় কোষ দেখে বোঝা যায় সে ভালো খেয়েছে।
যোগ অনুশীলন করে অন্নময় কোষকে শক্তিশালী করা যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: From his annamaya kosha, it's clear he eats well.
Yoga practice can strengthen the annamaya kosha.
history: Derived from the Taittiriya Upanishad in ancient Hindu scriptures, describing the five koshas or sheaths of the self, where annamaya kosha is the physical body sustained by food.
note: This term is more philosophical than a colloquial idiom, originating from Vedantic texts.
